intro: Minneapolis's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $112/month, up 1.8% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). StorageUnitCosts lists $114 (August 2026). Storage Stats puts the Minneapolis–St. Paul metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $106, up 1.9% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $122. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); Aug 2026 (StorageUnitCosts); Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $46 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $45 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$50.

Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $61 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $62 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$73. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $112, up 1.8% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $114, up 2.7% from a year earlier (Aug 2026). Storage Stats Minneapolis–St. Paul metro non-climate asking rent $106, up 1.9% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Minneapolis alone. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$122.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $150 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$172.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $201 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $203 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$227.

local_tips: Minneapolis has about 22 facilities and 2.1 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
